title: vitex peduncularis var. roxburghiana
intro: Vitex peduncularis var. roxburghiana, commonly known as Chinese chastetree, is a plant species used in traditional medicine. It is valued for its health benefits, which include the improvement of menstrual irregularities, anxiety, and sleep disorders, as well as its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Vitex peduncularis var. roxburghiana include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-anxiety effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids.
